prompts.text: Author the exact Task 7 body or head identity against its rig-specific organic connector grammar, keeping the head shell blank and preserving a layered foreground/background seam.

sharedContract: One isolated front-orthographic plush 3D structural component. Preserve the v0.2 identity reference but author against the exact rig guide. Bodies use an organic recessed neck receiver with continuous shoulder lips. Heads use a downward tapered organic neck tongue and distinct lower back/foreground seam regions. No flat cuts, rectangular notches, baked pedestals, hardware, body on a head, head on a body, limbs, or baked facial features. Keep generous transparent-looking margin for deterministic checker extraction.
